ApplyScalingGroup.description_en: Creates and manages Elastic Container Instance (ECI)-based scaling groups by using a configuration file. You can call the ApplyScalingGroup operation to implement this feature
ApplyScalingGroup.description_zh: 如果您需要通过配置文件方式快速创建和管理ECI类型的伸缩组，则可以通过调用API ApplyScalingGroup来实现该功能

AttachAlbServerGroups.description_en: Adds one or more Application Load Balancer (ALB) server groups to a scaling group
AttachAlbServerGroups.description_zh: 向伸缩组添加一个或多个ALB服务器组

AttachDBInstances.description_en: Adds one or more ApsaraDB RDS instances to a scaling group
AttachDBInstances.description_zh: 通过调用API AttachDBInstances为伸缩组添加一个或多个RDS实例，可实现根据您的需要随时调整伸缩组内的RDS实例数量，增加您使用上的灵活性与实用性

AttachInstances.description_en: Manually adds ECS instances to a scaling group
AttachInstances.description_zh: 调用API AttachInstances将实例手动添加到伸缩组中，即您可以将伸缩组以外的ECS实例、ECI实例或托管实例添加到伸缩组中并提供服务，或者将伸缩组中处于节省停机状态的ECS实例重新启动变为服务状态（运行中状态）并在伸缩组中提供服务

AttachLoadBalancers.description_en: Adds one or more load balancing instances
AttachLoadBalancers.description_zh: 伸缩组支持关联负载均衡实例，通过负载均衡实例将访问流量分发到伸缩组内的多个实例中，可以有效增强伸缩组的服务能力，您可以调用API AttachLoadBalancers添加一个或多个负载均衡实例

AttachServerGroups.description_en: Adds one or more load balancing server groups to a scaling group. Supported server group types include Application Load Balancer (ALB) and Network Load Balancer (NLB)
AttachServerGroups.description_zh: 从伸缩组添加一个或多个负载均衡服务器组，支持的服务器组类型包括：应用型负载均衡ALB (Application Load Balancer)、网络型负载均衡NLB (Network Load Balancer)

AttachVServerGroups.description_en: Adds one or more virtual server groups to a load balancing instance associated with a scaling group
AttachVServerGroups.description_zh: 添加负载均衡实例下的一个或者多个虚拟服务器组。

CancelInstanceRefresh.description_en: Cancels an instance refresh task. Instances that have already been replaced or added during scale-out are retained
CancelInstanceRefresh.description_zh: 取消实例刷新任务，会保留已经完成替换和扩容的新实例

ChangeResourceGroup.description_en: Changes the resource group of a scaling group
ChangeResourceGroup.description_zh: 将一个伸缩组作为资源加入一个资源组

CompleteLifecycleAction.description_en: Ends the wait state of a scaling activity in advance
CompleteLifecycleAction.description_zh: 提前结束伸缩活动的等待状态

CreateAlarm.description_zh: 针对具有突发性或时间上不易预测的业务，调用CreateAlarm创建一个报警任务，该任务关联云监控指标后，可以动态调整伸缩组内的ECS实例或ECI实例数量，并实时监控实例指标，帮助您更好地管理和维护云资源

CreateEciScalingConfiguration.description_zh: 创建一个ECI类型的伸缩配置

CreateLifecycleHook.description_en: Creates one or more lifecycle hooks for a scaling group
CreateLifecycleHook.description_zh: 为伸缩组创建一个或多个生命周期挂钩

CreateNotificationConfiguration.description_en: Event notifications support automatically sending messages to the CloudMonitor monitoring service, MNS topics, and MNS queues after specified types of events occur, which helps you keep track of scaling group dynamics and further implement automated management. If the current event notification types no longer meet your business requirements, you can invoke the ModifyNotificationConfiguration API operation to modify auto scaling event and resource change notifications in Auto Scaling. You do not need to create a new event notification, but modifying the notification method of an event notification is not supported
CreateNotificationConfiguration.description_zh: 事件通知支持在发生指定类型的事件后，自动发送消息到云监控、MNS主题和MNS队列，可以帮助您及时掌握伸缩组的动态，进一步实现自动化管理。如果当前事件通知的类型不再满足业务需求，您可以调用API ModifyNotificationConfiguration修改弹性伸缩事件及资源变化通知，您无需重新创建新的事件通知，但不支持修改事件通知的通知方式

CreateScalingConfiguration.description_en: Creates an ECS-type scaling configuration for a scaling group by calling the CreateScalingConfiguration operation with the scaling group ID, instance type, instance image, and other information
CreateScalingConfiguration.description_zh: 通过调用CreateScalingConfiguration接口，并指定伸缩组ID、实例规格、实例镜像等信息，为伸缩组创建一个ECS类型的伸缩配置

CreateScalingGroup.description_en: Creates a scaling group to automatically adjust computing capacity by adding or removing instances based on business requirements and policies
CreateScalingGroup.description_zh: 如果您需要根据业务变动需求与策略自动增加或减少指定类型的实例数量，则可以通过调用API CreateScalingGroup创建伸缩组来自动调整您的业务计算能力（即实例数量）

DeactivateScalingConfiguration.description_zh: 使指定伸缩配置进入失效状态

DeleteEciScalingConfiguration.description_zh: 删除一个ECI类型的伸缩配置

DeleteLifecycleHook.description_zh: 删除一个生命周期挂钩。

DeleteNotificationConfiguration.description_en: Deletes a notification configuration for Auto Scaling events and resource changes
DeleteNotificationConfiguration.description_zh: 删除一条弹性伸缩事件及资源变化通知

DescribeAlarms.description_en: Queries the information of event-triggered tasks

DescribeAlertConfiguration.description_en: When a scaling activity succeeds, fails, or is rejected, Auto Scaling can send notifications through SMS messages and emails. You must handle the related events after receiving the notifications. You can call the DescribeAlertConfiguration operation to query the status of scaling activities for which SMS and email notifications are sent in a scaling group. This helps you stay informed about changes to scaling activities and respond quickly to improve scaling efficiency
DescribeAlertConfiguration.description_zh: 伸缩活动在执行成功、失败或者被拒绝时，弹性伸缩支持通过短信、邮件方式发送消息通知，您需要在接收到消息后自行处理相关事件。您可以调用API DescribeAlertConfiguration查询伸缩组中的发送短信、邮件通知的伸缩活动状态，方便您及时了解某个伸缩活动的变化，快速响应提高扩缩容效率

DescribeEciScalingConfigurations.description_en: Invokes the DescribeEciScalingConfigurations operation. You can specify parameters such as the scaling group ID, and the IDs or names of the scaling configurations to perform a parameter query for ECI scaling configuration information, such as the instance preemption policy, container group instance types, container image pull policies, and the weight of the ECI instance when it acts as a backend server
DescribeEciScalingConfigurations.description_zh: 调用DescribeEciScalingConfigurations接口，并可以指定伸缩组的ID、伸缩配置的ID或名称等参数查询ECI类型的伸缩配置信息，例如实例的抢占策略、容器组的实例规格、容器镜像的拉取策略、ECI实例作为后端服务器时的权重等

DescribeElasticStrength.description_en: The validity of a scaling group configuration largely determines the success rate of scale-out operations. Auto Scaling uses elastic strength to describe the validity of scaling configurations, quantifying configuration quality and helping you optimize scaling configurations accordingly
DescribeElasticStrength.description_zh: 伸缩组配置的有效性很大程度决定了扩容过程的成功率。弹性伸缩通过弹性强度描述伸缩配置的有效性，让配置的优良程度量化，帮助用户针对性的优化伸缩配置

DescribeInstanceRefreshes.description_en: Queries instance refresh tasks of a scaling group, including basic information and progress of the tasks
DescribeInstanceRefreshes.description_zh: 如果您需要查看实例刷新任务的基本信息、 实例刷新任务的进度等信息，您可以调用DescribeInstanceRefreshes查询该伸缩组的实例刷新任务

DescribeLifecycleActions.description_en: Queries lifecycle tokens by scaling activity ID and status
DescribeLifecycleActions.description_zh: 根据伸缩活动ID和状态查询 Lifecycle Token

DescribeLifecycleHooks.description_en: Queries the information of lifecycle hooks by specifying lifecycle hook IDs or scaling group IDs. The information includes the next action to execute after the suspended state ends, the scaling activity type associated with the lifecycle hook, the Notification Recipient identifier, and the suspend wait time
DescribeLifecycleHooks.description_zh: 调用DescribeLifecycleHooks通过指定生命周期挂钩ID或伸缩组ID来查询生命周期挂钩的信息，包括等待状态结束后的下一步动作、生命周期挂钩对应的伸缩活动类型、通知对象标识符、挂起等待时间等

DescribeNotificationConfigurations.description_en: Queries the notification configurations for Auto Scaling events and resource changes of a scaling group, including event notification types and notification methods
DescribeNotificationConfigurations.description_zh: 调用API DescribeNotificationConfiguration，通过伸缩组ID查询该伸缩组的弹性伸缩事件及资源变化通知，包括事件通知类型和通知方式等

DescribeNotificationTypes.description_en: Queries the types of Auto Scaling events and resource change notifications
DescribeNotificationTypes.description_zh: 查询弹性伸缩事件及资源变化通知的类型。

DescribePatternTypes.description_en: Queries instance types that match specified instance attributes, such as the number of vCPUs, memory size, instance family level, and maximum acceptable price, when you configure a scaling configuration by specifying instance attributes. This operation calls the DescribePatternTypes API operation
DescribePatternTypes.description_zh: 使用指定实例属性方式配置伸缩配置时，调用API DescribePatternTypes接口根据指定实例的vCPU核数、内存大小、规格族级别以及可接受的最高价格等属性，筛选出符合要求的实例规格

DescribeRegions.description_en: Queries the regions where Auto Scaling is available
DescribeRegions.description_zh: 查询可以使用弹性伸缩服务的地域

DescribeScalingActivities.description_en: Queries the details of scaling activities by calling the DescribeScalingActivities operation. You can use this operation to view the results of scaling activities triggered by scheduled tasks, event-triggered tasks, or manual execution of scaling rules. For example, you can view the status, cause, and total number of instances after the change for a scaling activity
DescribeScalingActivities.description_zh: 通过API DescribeScalingActivities查看伸缩活动的详情，了解通过定时任务、报警任务或手动执行伸缩规则等方式触发伸缩活动的结果。例如，您可以在伸缩活动详情页查看到伸缩活动的状态、活动起因、变化后总实例数等信息

DescribeScalingActivityDetail.description_en: Queries the details of a scaling activity
DescribeScalingActivityDetail.description_zh: 查询一个伸缩活动的详细信息

DescribeScalingConfigurations.description_en: Queries information about ECS-type scaling configurations, including instance types and images, to help you understand the details of ECS instance templates used for scale-out in advance
DescribeScalingConfigurations.description_zh: 调用API DescribeScalingConfigurations查询ECS类型伸缩配置的信息，包括实例规格、镜像等信息，方便您提前了解弹性扩张时使用的ECS实例模板详情

DescribeScalingGroups.description_en: Queries the details of scaling groups, including basic information, instances in the scaling groups, and scaling configurations
DescribeScalingGroups.description_zh: 如果您需要查看伸缩组的基本信息、伸缩组内实例、伸缩配置等信息，您可以调用API DescribeScalingGroups查询该伸缩组

DescribeScalingInstances.description_en: Queries the list and details of ECS instances in a scaling group by scaling group ID. The details include the total number of running spot instances, the total number of ECS instances, and the warmup and lifecycle states of the ECS instances in the scaling group. This operation also allows you to filter ECS instances by health status, lifecycle state, and creation type
DescribeScalingInstances.description_zh: 调用DescribeScalingInstances，通过伸缩组ID查询该伸缩组内的ECS实例列表及实例信息，包括当前伸缩组中，运行状态的抢占式实例总数、ECS实例总数、ECS实例的预热状态、生命周期状态等。同时也支持指定实例健康状态、生命周期状态、创建方式等筛选符合要求的ECS实例

DescribeScalingRules.description_en: Queries the scaling rules in a scaling group and returns information about the scaling rules
DescribeScalingRules.description_zh: 查询伸缩组下的伸缩规则，并列出伸缩规则的信息

DescribeScheduledTasks.description_en: Queries the details of scheduled tasks. A scheduled task is a preset node that executes a specified scaling rule at a specified time to implement automatic scale-out and scale-in of compute resources. After you create a scheduled task, you can invoke the DescribeScheduledTasks API operation to query its details, such as the trigger time, total number of scheduled tasks, and the ID of the scaling group that executes the scheduled task
DescribeScheduledTasks.description_zh: 定时任务是一种预设任务，可以在指定时间执行指定的伸缩规则，实现计算资源的自动扩缩容。定时任务创建完成后，您可以调用API DescribeScheduledTasks查询定时任务的详细信息，例如，定时任务的触发时间点、定时任务总数、执行定时任务的伸缩组的ID等

DetachAlbServerGroups.description_en: Removes one or more Application Load Balancer (ALB) server groups from a scaling group
DetachAlbServerGroups.description_zh: 从伸缩组移出一个或多个ALB服务器组

DetachDBInstances.description_en: Removes one or more ApsaraDB RDS instances
DetachDBInstances.description_zh: 如果您需要减少伸缩组内的RDS实例，可以通过调用API DetachDBInstance移除一个或多个RDS实例，来改变伸缩组与RDS实例的强行绑定关系，增加您使用上的灵活性与实用性

DetachInstances.description_en: Removes one or more ECS instances from a scaling group
DetachInstances.description_zh: 如果当前伸缩组状态为启用状态，且伸缩组内不存在执行中的伸缩活动，您可以调用API DetachInstances从一个伸缩组移出一台或多台ECS实例、ECI实例或托管实例

DetachLoadBalancers.description_en: Removes one or more load balancing instances
DetachLoadBalancers.description_zh: 如果当前弹性伸缩组关联的负载均衡实例不能满足您的需求或者您需要取消关联，调用DetachLoadBalancers，通过指定伸缩组的ID、负载均衡实例的ID、ForceDetach等配置参数，移除一个或多个负载均衡 CLB（原 SLB）实例，同时可以选择异步调用以及是否移除负载均衡实例后端服务器中属于当前伸缩组的ECS实例。该接口仅支持移除负载均衡 CLB（原 SLB）实例

DetachServerGroups.description_en: Invokes the DetachServerGroups API to remove one or more load balancing server groups from a scaling group. Supported server group types include Application Load Balancer (ALB) load balancing, Network Load Balancer (NLB) load balancing, and Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) load balancing. This operation dynamically adjusts the load balancing policy and improves system high availability for scenarios that require dynamic instance scaling to handle fluctuating workloads and ensure that application programs remain active
DetachServerGroups.description_zh: 对于需要动态调整实例数量来应对业务变化负载以及确保应用程序的高可用性场景，调用API DetachServerGroups从伸缩组移除一个或多个负载均衡服务器组，支持的服务器组类型包括应用型负载均衡ALB、网络型负载均衡NLB和网关型负载均衡GWLB，可以实现对负载均衡策略的动态调整，并帮助提高系统的高可用性

DetachVServerGroups.description_en: Removes one or more virtual server groups
DetachVServerGroups.description_zh: 移除一个或者多个虚拟服务器组

EnableScalingGroup.description_zh: 如果伸缩组处于停用状态，并且该伸缩组已通过指定启动模板方式或者创建并启用伸缩配置方式指定了实例配置来源，您可以调用API EnableScalingGroup启用一个伸缩组，通过弹性伸缩来自动调整您的业务计算能力（即实例数量）

EnterStandby.description_en: Puts ECS instances in a scaling group into the standby state
EnterStandby.description_zh: 调用API EnterStandby将伸缩组内的ECS实例或ECI实例设置为备用状态，方便您自行管理ECS实例或ECI实例的生命周期

ExitStandby.description_en: Transitions ECS instances in a scaling group from the standby state to the running state
ExitStandby.description_zh: 伸缩组内发生伸缩活动时，不会移出处于备用状态的ECS实例或ECI实例。如果您需要再次使用该实例参与伸缩活动，您可以调用API ExitStandby将伸缩组中处于备用状态的ECS实例或ECI实例移出备用状态并转化为运行状态

ListTagKeys.description_en: Queries the tag keys of Auto Scaling resources
ListTagKeys.description_zh: 查询弹性伸缩资源标签键的列表

ListTagResources.description_en: Queries the tags bound to one or more Auto Scaling resources
ListTagResources.description_zh: 查询一个或多个弹性伸缩资源已经绑定的标签列表

ListTagValues.description_en: Queries the tag values corresponding to a tag key of Auto Scaling resources
ListTagValues.description_zh: 查询弹性伸缩资源标签键对应的标签值

ModifyAlertConfiguration.description_en: Configures the scaling activity statuses for which Auto Scaling sends SMS and email notifications within a scaling group. When a scaling activity succeeds, fails, or is rejected, Auto Scaling can send notifications via SMS or email. You must handle the related events after receiving the notifications. You can call the ModifyAlertConfiguration operation to set the scaling activity statuses that trigger SMS and email notifications in a scaling group, so that you can stay informed about scaling activity changes and respond promptly to improve scaling efficiency
ModifyAlertConfiguration.description_zh: 伸缩活动在执行成功、失败或者被拒绝时，弹性伸缩支持通过短信、邮件方式发送消息通知，您需要在接收到消息后自行处理相关事件。您可以调用API ModifyAlertConfiguration设置伸缩组中需要发送短信、邮件通知的伸缩活动状态，方便您及时了解某个伸缩活动的变化，快速响应提高扩缩容效率

ModifyEciScalingConfiguration.description_zh: 调用ModifyScalingConfiguration修改一个ECI类型的伸缩配置

ModifyInstanceAttribute.description_en: Modifies specific attributes of an ECS instance in a scaling group by specifying parameters such as the instance ID, scaling group ID, and region ID. Currently, only the lifecycle management attribute of instances manually added to the scaling group can be modified
ModifyInstanceAttribute.description_zh: 调用ModifyInstanceAttribute，并指定伸缩组内实例的ID、伸缩组的ID、伸缩组所属的地域ID等参数，修改伸缩组中一台ECS实例的部分信息，目前仅支持修改手动添加到伸缩组中实例的生命周期托管属性

ModifyLifecycleHook.description_en: Modifies the information of a lifecycle hook
ModifyLifecycleHook.description_zh: 修改一个生命周期挂钩的信息。

ModifyNotificationConfiguration.description_en: Modifies an Auto Scaling event and resource change notification
ModifyNotificationConfiguration.description_zh: 修改一条弹性伸缩事件及资源变化通知

ModifyScalingConfiguration.description_en: Modifies an ECS-type scaling configuration (the ECS instance template for scale-out) if the current scaling configuration does not meet your business requirements. You can invoke this API operation to modify the scaling configuration
ModifyScalingConfiguration.description_zh: 如果当前的伸缩配置不满足业务需求，您可以通过调用API ModifyScalingConfiguration修改ECS类型的伸缩配置（即待扩容的ECS实例模板）

ModifyScalingGroup.description_en: Modifies the attributes of a scaling group. You can configure a scaling group to automatically adjust your computing capacity by adding or removing instances of a specified type based on your business needs and policies. If the current attributes of a scaling group no longer meet your business requirements, you can call this operation to modify attributes such as the maximum number of instances, minimum number of instances, or expected number of instances. This prevents the need to recreate the scaling group and reconfigure its attributes, which saves time and resource costs
ModifyScalingGroup.description_zh: 如果您需要根据业务变动需求与策略自动增加或减少指定类型的实例数量，则可以通过配置伸缩组来自动调整您的业务计算能力（即实例数量）。如果当前伸缩组属性不再满足业务需求，则您可以调用API ModifyScalingGroup修改伸缩组属性（例如最大实例数、最小实例数或期望实例数等属性），避免重新创建伸缩组并重新配置相关属性，节省了时间和资源成本

ModifyScalingRule.description_en: Modifies one or more attributes of a scaling rule. If an existing scaling rule no longer meets your requirements, you can call this operation to modify its attributes instead of creating a new one. This prevents unnecessary repetition and saves time and resources
ModifyScalingRule.description_zh: 创建伸缩规则后，如果当前伸缩规则不再满足需求，您可以调用API ModifyScalingRule修改一项或多项伸缩规则属性，无需重新创建新的伸缩规则，避免不必要的重复操作，节约时间和资源成本

ModifyScheduledTask.description_en: Modifies the information of a scheduled task
ModifyScheduledTask.description_zh: 如果当前伸缩组的定时任务不能满足业务需求，您可以调用ModifyScheduledTask接口，通过指定定时任务的ID修改已有定时任务的配置参数：需要执行的伸缩规则、伸缩组内实例数量、任务执行频率、重试策略等

RebalanceInstances.description_en: Rebalances the distribution of ECS instances in a multi-zone scaling group
RebalanceInstances.description_zh: 重新平衡多可用区伸缩组内ECS实例的分布

RecordLifecycleActionHeartbeat.description_en: Extends the wait time of an ECS instance that is suspended after a lifecycle hook is triggered
RecordLifecycleActionHeartbeat.description_zh: 延长一个生命周期挂钩触发后被挂起的ECS实例的等待时间

RemoveInstances.description_en: If the current scaling group is in the enable state and no scaling activity is in the execute state in the scaling group, you can invoke the RemoveInstances API operation to delete one or more unneeded instances from a scaling group
RemoveInstances.description_zh: 如果当前伸缩组状态为启用状态，且伸缩组内不存在执行中的伸缩活动，您可以调用API RemoveInstances从一个伸缩组删除一台或多台不再需要的实例

ResumeInstanceRefresh.description_en: Resumes an instance refresh task that is in the paused state
ResumeInstanceRefresh.description_zh: 恢复一个处于暂停状态的实例刷新任务

ResumeProcesses.description_en: Resumes the suspended processes in a scaling group
ResumeProcesses.description_zh: 您可以主动调用API ResumeProcesses恢复伸缩组中被暂停的流程，由伸缩组继续按功能逻辑执行指定流程。例如，您恢复健康检查流程后，如果伸缩组某实例被视为不健康就会自动被移出伸缩组

RollbackInstanceRefresh.description_en: Rolls back an instance refresh task during execution. If the desired configuration no longer meets your requirements during an instance refresh task, call this operation to roll back the task. During the rollback, the system creates new instances based on the currently active configuration of the scaling group to replace instances that were created based on the desired configuration
RollbackInstanceRefresh.description_zh: 在实例刷新任务执行过程中，如果发现期望配置不符合需求，您可以调用此API来回滚实例刷新任务。在回滚时，系统将使用伸缩组当前生效的配置来创建新的实例，以替换那些基于期望配置创建的实例

ScaleWithAdjustment.description_en: Triggers elastic scaling based on a specified adjustment rule
ScaleWithAdjustment.description_zh: 区别于ExecuteScalingRule接口，您无需提前创建伸缩规则，直接调用API ScaleWithAdjustment接口快速基于指定调整规则触发弹性扩缩容

SetGroupDeletionProtection.description_en: Enables or disables deletion protection for a scaling group
SetGroupDeletionProtection.description_zh: 为伸缩组开启或关闭删除保护

SetInstanceHealth.description_en: Sets the health status of an ECS instance in a scaling group
SetInstanceHealth.description_zh: 设置伸缩组内ECS实例的健康状态

SetInstancesProtection.description_en: Enables or disables protection for one or more ECS instances in a scaling group
SetInstancesProtection.description_zh: 调用API SetInstancesProtection可以保护或停止保护伸缩组内的一台或者多台ECS实例。开启ECS实例的保护功能后，伸缩组自动缩容时该实例不会被终止或释放，仅可手动在控制台或通过调用API RemoveInstances删除该实例

StartInstanceRefresh.description_en: Refreshes instances in a scaling group when you need to apply a new scaling configuration or update the image of instances in the scaling group
StartInstanceRefresh.description_zh: 在您需要将新的伸缩配置应用到伸缩组实例中时，或需要更新伸缩组中实例的镜像时，您可以调用本接口完成伸缩组中实例的刷新

SuspendInstanceRefresh.description_en: Pauses an instance refresh task. During the execution of an instance refresh task, if you suspect that the configuration has issues but are not sure whether a rollback is needed, you can call this operation to pause the instance refresh task. During the pause, you can check whether the configuration is correct
SuspendInstanceRefresh.description_zh: 实例刷新任务执行期间，如果您觉得配置存在问题，但不确定是否需要回滚，您可以调用此API暂停实例刷新任务，在此期间，您可以检查配置是否正确

SuspendProcesses.description_en: Suspends specified processes in a scaling group
SuspendProcesses.description_zh: 通过调用API SuspendProcesses主动暂停伸缩组某些指定流程，然后去执行其他操作，方便您更加精细地控制伸缩组活动

TagResources.description_en: Creates and binds tags to a specified list of Auto Scaling resources
TagResources.description_zh: 为指定的弹性伸缩资源列表统一创建并绑定标签

UntagResources.description_en: After a tag is unbound, the tag is automatically deleted if it is not bound to any other resources
UntagResources.description_zh: 调用API UntagResources为指定的弹性伸缩资源列表统一解绑标签，可以简化资源管理、提高系统性能优化、降低安全风险。解绑标签后，如果该标签没有绑定其他任何资源，则会被自动删除

VerifyAuthentication.description_en: Checks whether Auto Scaling is authorized to operate ECS resources
VerifyAuthentication.description_zh: 检测是否已授权弹性伸缩调操作ECS资源

VerifyUser.description_en: Verifies whether Auto Scaling is activated
VerifyUser.description_zh: 通过调用API VerifyUser验证是否已开通弹性伸缩服务
